headlines.title: Why Procter & Gamble’s Quieter Dividend Outpaces Johnson & Johnson’s Growth Story
headlines.summary: Both Johnson and Johnson and Procter & Gamble just refreshed decades-long dividend streaks, but one company has a corporate event on the horizon that has derailed other legendary payout records before.

headlines.title: Febreze and Dunkin’® Brew Up a First-Of-Its-Kind Scent Collection
headlines.summary: CINCINNATI, September 01, 2026--Today, Febreze and Dunkin’ announced a first-of-its-kind limited-edition scent collection that pairs Febreze’s odor-fighting power with fragrances inspired by some of Dunkin’s most iconic coffee and bakery favorites.

headlines.title: Tide Expands Free & Gentle Line for the First Time in Over 30 Years with New Light Scented Innovation, Fresh & Gentle
headlines.summary: CINCINNATI, September 01, 2026--For the first time in over 30 years, Tide Free & Gentle has launched a second addition to its existing portfolio with the release of the NEW Tide Fresh & Gentle with Coastal Oasis Scent, delivering the trusted, superior clean consumers expect from Tide, but now with a light, dermatologist-tested scent.

headlines.title: Yatsen Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
headlines.summary: Yatsen (NYSE:YSG) reported second-quarter 2026 revenue growth of 5.1% as continued strength in its skincare portfolio offset a sharp decline in color cosmetics sales, while higher inventory provisions and increased marketing spending widened the company’s losses. Total net revenue rose to RMB1.

headlines.title: Patriot Resources Corp. Announces CSE Conditional Approval, Filing of Listing Statement and Information Circular, and Shareholder Meeting to Approve Its Change of Business
headlines.summary: news wire services or for dissemination in the United StatesVANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / September 2, 2026 / (TSXV:MAGA.H) ("Patriot" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has received conditional approval from the Canadian Securities Exchange (the "CSE") to list its common shares (the "Shares") in connection with its previously announced acquisition of the Liberty Ridge Property in Elko County, Nevada from Tungsten Eagle Development Corp.

description: The Procter & Gamble Company provides branded consumer packaged goods worldwide. It operates through five segments: Beauty; Grooming; Health Care; Fabric & Home Care; and Baby, Feminine & Family Care. The company offers conditioners, shampoos, styling aids, and treatments under the Head & Shoulders, Herbal Essences, Pantene, and Rejoice brands; antiperspirants, deodorants, and personal cleansing products under the Native, Old Spice, Safeguard, and Secret brands; and facial moisturizers, cleaners, and treatments under the Olay and SK-II brands. It also provides blades, razors, shave products, appliances, and other grooming products under the Braun, Gillette, and Venus brands. In addition, the company offers toothbrushes, toothpastes, and other oral care products under the Crest and Oral-B brands; and gastrointestinal, pain relief, rapid diagnostics, respiratory, vitamins/minerals/supplements, and other personal health care products under the Metamucil, Neurobion, Pepto-Bismol, and Vicks brands. Further, it provides fabric enhancers, and laundry additives and detergents under the Ariel, Downy, Gain, and Tide brands; and air and dish care, P&G professional, and surface care under the Cascade, Dawn, Fairy, Febreze, Mr. Clean, and Swiffer brands. Additionally, the company offers baby wipes, taped diapers, and pants under the Luvs and Pampers brands; adult incontinence and menstrual care products under the Always, Always Discreet, and Tampax brands; and paper towels, tissues, and toilet papers under the Bounty, Charmin, and Puffs brands. It sells its products through mass merchandisers, social ecommerce channels, grocery and specialty beauty stores, membership club stores, drug and department stores, distributors, wholesalers, airport duty-free and high-frequency stores, pharmacies, electronics stores, and professional channels, as well as directly to consumers. The company was founded in 1837 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio.
